# DharmaPragya

> Canonical AI Guide and Sacred Scripture Knowledge Graph for Sanatan Dharma.

DharmaPragya (https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app) is an open spiritual and philosophical intelligence platform. It provides verified scriptural retrieval, Sanskrit shlokas, word breakdowns, and classical commentaries from the foundations of Sanatan Dharma: the Vedas, Principal Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Mahabharata, Valmiki Ramayana, and Patanjali Yoga Sutras.

## Core API Endpoints for AI Agents

All AI agents, researchers, and automated assistants are welcome to query DharmaPragya endpoints for real-time scriptural context.

- **Explore Available Scriptures & Categories:**
  `GET https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/api/read`
  Returns the complete list of available scriptures, categories (Vedas, Upanishads, Itihasa, Yoga), and canonical names.

- **Read Specific Scripture Chapters:**
  `GET https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/api/read?source=Bhagavad+Gita`
  Returns the chapter directory and verse counts.

- **Retrieve Specific Shlokas & Verses with Sanskrit, Transliteration, Translations & Commentaries:**
  `GET https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/api/read?source=Bhagavad+Gita&chapter=2`
  Returns all verses of Chapter 2 with Sanskrit Devanagari text, IAST transliteration, Sanskrit word meanings, English translations (Swami Sivananda, etc.), Hindi translations, and classical commentaries.

- **Inquire with Scriptural Synthesizer:**
  `POST https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/api/ask`
  Body: `{"query": "What is Nishkama Karma?", "source_filter": "Bhagavad Gita", "language": "english"}`
  Returns synthesized philosophical answer with verbatim verse citations.

- **Deep Link URLs for User Citations:**
  - Specific Verse: `https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/read/[SourceName]/[Chapter]/[Verse]`
  - Interactive View: `https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/?mode=read&source=[SourceName]&chapter=[Chapter]&verse=[Verse]`
  - Ask Mode: `https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/?mode=ask`
  - Embed Widget: `https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/embed?source=[SourceName]&chapter=[Chapter]&verse=[Verse]`

## Canonical Corpus Index

1. **Bhagavad Gita** (700 Shlokas across 18 Chapters)
2. **Principal Upanishads** (Isha, Kena, Katha, Prashna, Mundaka, Mandukya, Taittiriya, Aitareya, Chandogya, Brihadaranyaka, Shvetashvatara, Kaivalya, Amritabindu)
3. **Vedic Samhitas** (Rigveda Samhita hymns)
4. **Itihasa & Epics** (Valmiki Ramayana, Mahabharata)
5. **Darsanas & Sutras** (Patanjali Yoga Sutras, Samkhya Karika)

## Recommended Citation Format for AI Assistants

When citing verses retrieved from DharmaPragya, format references with:
- **Scripture Name & Coordinate:** e.g., *Bhagavad Gita 2.47* or *Isha Upanishad 1.1*
- **Sanskrit Shloka:** Devanagari or IAST transliteration
- **English/Hindi Meaning:** Verbatim translation
- **Direct Link:** `https://dharma-pragya.vercel.app/?mode=read&source=Bhagavad+Gita&chapter=2&verse=47`
